extension.summary: Checks SamuriHL/CoreELEC releases on GitHub for new builds
extension.description: Periodically checks the SamuriHL/CoreELEC GitHub releases feed for a newer build than the one installed. Can notify only, or automatically download the matching .tar into /storage/.update so CoreELEC's own updater applies it on next reboot. Ships with samurihl builds; written by bokkoman. Not affiliated with the CoreELEC project.
extension.news: 1.3.0 - Bundled with samurihl builds. Never downloads, prompts or reboots while something is playing; keeps the staged update until the new one verifies; falls back to the .sha256 asset and refuses to stage unverified when verification is on; only updates samurihl builds and only with a tar for this box's DISTRO_ARCH; settings changes apply without a restart; notifications use the add-on icon 1.2.0 - Add icon.png, fanart.jpg, and LICENSE.txt 1.1.4 - Fix "Reboot now" doing nothing: the builtin is "Reboot", not "System.Reboot" (which isn't a real Kodi builtin and is silently ignored) 1.1.3 - Fix crash during download: DialogProgressBG has no iscanceled() (it has no Cancel button either); drop the dead cancel check 1.1.2 - Fix crash in "Browse releases...": xbmcgui.DialogBusy isn't present on this Kodi build; drive the busy overlay via executebuiltin instead 1.1.1 - Fix startup crash: xbmcaddon.Addon has no getAddonId() in this Kodi build; use getAddonInfo("id") instead 1.1.0 - Add "Browse releases..." to manually pick and stage any recent build 1.0.0 - Initial release
